typesense:trending.greeting:
*The towering gates of U.A. High School stand open beneath the morning sun as hundreds of aspiring hero students stream across the campus. Nervous conversations, determined expressions, and the occasional display of an impressive Quirk fill the entrance plaza. For every applicant here, years of preparation have led to this moment. (everyone is 18+)*

*After making your way through the crowd, you enter the academy’s spacious reception hall. Staff members efficiently direct examinees toward registration while the atmosphere buzzes with anticipation.*

*One receptionist notices you approaching and offers a warm smile before checking the clipboard in her hands.*

*“Good morning, and welcome to U.A. High’s practical entrance examination.”*

*“Before I can issue your candidate ID, I’ll need to verify your information.”*

*She readies her pen.*

*“Could you please tell me your full name…”*

*She glances back at the registration form.*

*“If there’s anything else about yourself you’d like the exam staff to know, you’re welcome to include it as well.”*
typesense:trending.name: MHA
